meaning_hint: Only the sport; the insect is цвіркун.
examples: They play cricket every Sunday in the park.
Cricket is very popular in India.
We watched a cricket match on TV.
He learned cricket in England.
note: Also an insect that chirps at night.

meaning_hint: Only the rhythm in music; to beat is бити; біт also means a computing bit.
examples: This song has a great beat.
He makes beats on his computer.
We danced to the beat.
The beat is slow and calm.
What's for dessert?
We had ice cream for dessert.
She makes a great chocolate dessert.
I'm too full for dessert.

meaning_hint: Short for максимум/максимальний (written макс.)
examples: The bus holds fifty people max.
It takes ten minutes max.
Turn the volume up to max.
We can spend twenty dollars max.
My favorite hobby is taking photos.
Do you have any hobbies?
She started painting as a hobby last year.
Fishing is a relaxing hobby for many people.
Africa is the second largest continent.
There are seven continents on Earth.
She has visited every continent except Antarctica.
Australia is both a country and a continent.

meaning_hint: The (World Wide) Web, web design (веб-дизайн); a spider's web is павутина.
examples: I found the recipe on the web.
She builds websites and web apps.
You can search the web for cheap flights.
Most news is now read on the web.

meaning_hint: Also a memorial sports tournament.
examples: They built a memorial for the soldiers.
We visited the war memorial in the park.
People left flowers at the memorial.
The memorial stands in the center of the city.
The game's publisher announced a new release date.
She works for a small book publisher.
The publisher paid for the ads.
He sent his book to five publishers.

meaning_hint: A modern loanword (psychology, marketing); everyday Ukrainian: розуміння. Not інсайд (insider info)
examples: The report gives insight into customer habits.
She shared some useful insights in the meeting.
The data gave us new insights.
His book offers deep insight into the market.

meaning_hint: Trade term for cotton fabric (often written коттон); the everyday word is бавовна.
examples: This shirt is made of cotton.
Cotton is soft and comfortable in summer.
She prefers cotton sheets.
These socks are 100 percent cotton.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian a noun (a gay man); the old exclamation гей! = hey!
examples: He is the first gay to win this award.
Many gays and lesbians live here.
The club welcomes gays of all ages.
She has many gay friends.
note: As a noun it can sound rude; "gay man" or "gay people" is better.

meaning_hint: Business/finance term; the everyday word for a price reduction is знижка.
examples: We got a ten percent discount on the shoes.
Students get a discount at the museum.
Do you offer a discount for cash?
The store gives discounts on Black Friday.

meaning_hint: Ukrainian інструмент also means a tool; in English a hammer or a saw is a tool.
examples: Do you play an instrument?
The piano is my favorite instrument.
She plays three instruments.
The band uses old instruments.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian also a chess opening.
examples: This is her debut album.
He made his debut in the film last year.
Their debut song was a big hit.
The band played their debut show here.
My son loves books about dinosaurs.
The museum has a huge dinosaur skeleton.
Dinosaurs lived millions of years ago.
They found dinosaur bones in the desert.
Turn on the GPS before we leave.
The GPS showed the fastest route.
My phone's GPS doesn't work here.
We got lost because the GPS was wrong.

meaning_hint: Only a goal scored in a game; an aim is мета, the goal frame is ворота.
examples: He scored a goal in the last minute.
The team won by two goals.
What a great goal!
She scored the first goal of the game.

meaning_hint: bookish or figurative (a gem); the everyday word is перлина
examples: She wore a necklace of white pearls.
Divers search for pearls at the bottom of the sea.
A pearl grows slowly inside an oyster.
Her grandmother gave her a pair of pearl earrings.
I got a back massage after work.
A massage helps my muscles relax.
She booked a one-hour massage at the spa.
He gave me a quick neck massage.
I ride my bicycle to work every day.
He bought a new bicycle for his son.
Lock your bicycle outside the store.
My bicycle has a flat tire.
note: "Bike" is more common in everyday speech.

examples: He was diagnosed with a rare syndrome.
Chronic fatigue syndrome makes people very tired.
The doctor explained the syndrome to us.
This syndrome affects children.
The pastor gave a short sermon.
Our pastor visits sick people.
She asked the pastor for advice.
The pastor married them in the church.

meaning_hint: Only the card game; a fire poker is кочерга.
examples: We play poker every Friday night.
He won fifty dollars at poker.
She is very good at poker.
Let's play a game of poker.
I do yoga every morning before work.
She teaches yoga at the local gym.
Yoga helps me relax after a long day.
Bring your own mat to yoga class.
The doctors found a small tumor.
The tumor was not cancer.
She had surgery to remove the tumor.
The tumor grew slowly over years.
Update your profile with a new photo.
I looked at his profile online.
Her profile says she lives in Boston.
You can edit your profile anytime.
The jury reached a verdict after two days.
The verdict was "not guilty."
Everyone waited quietly for the verdict.
His lawyer will appeal the verdict.

meaning_hint: Only rap music; a knock (a rap on the door) = стук.
examples: He listens to rap every day.
She writes her own rap lyrics.
Rap became popular in the eighties.
Do you like rap or rock better?

meaning_hint: Indeclinable; also spelled еґо.
examples: His ego is too big to admit mistakes.
Winning the game gave her ego a boost.
Don't let your ego get in the way.
The criticism hurt his ego.

meaning_hint: formal Ukrainian: кінцевий термін
examples: The deadline for the project is Friday.
I missed the deadline by one day.
We worked late to meet the deadline.
Can we move the deadline to next week?
Police found cocaine in the car.
Cocaine is an illegal drug.
He was arrested for selling cocaine.
Cocaine is very addictive.
The doctors kept him under close monitoring.
Air quality monitoring is important in big cities.
The software does network monitoring.
Monitoring of the river continues every day.

meaning_hint: Ukrainian follows the Spanish pronunciation (х); English also spells it marihuana
examples: Marijuana is legal in some states.
Doctors sometimes prescribe medical marijuana.
He was caught with marijuana in his car.
The smell of marijuana filled the room.
He listened to punk all through high school.
The band plays loud, fast punk.
Punk became popular in the late seventies.
She still dresses like an old punk.
note: As a music style, "punk rock" is also common.

meaning_hint: also a shop assistant (консультант у магазині)
examples: The company hired a consultant.
She works as a business consultant.
The consultant gave us good advice.
Ask a tax consultant for help.

meaning_hint: Only the unit of length (0.91 m); a yard around a house is двір.
examples: The ball went ten yards.
The store is a hundred yards away.
He ran fifty yards.
A yard is about ninety centimeters.
Always make a backup of your important files.
I restored my photos from last week's backup.
Our company runs a backup every night.
Do you keep a backup on an external drive?
We live close to downtown.
Downtown is busy during the day.
The new hotel is in the heart of downtown.
Parking in downtown is expensive.
note: Often used without "the": I work downtown.

examples: We hired a company for office cleaning.
The cleaning service comes every Friday.
Cleaning is included in the rent.
She runs a small house cleaning business.
She is a regular blood donor.
They found a kidney donor for him.
The hospital needs more organ donors.
Donors must be at least eighteen years old.
We used a generator during the blackout.
The generator runs on gas.
Turn on the generator when the power goes out.
The hospital has a backup generator.
The movie has a high rating.
The hotel got a five-star rating.
Check the ratings before you buy.
The show's ratings went down.

meaning_hint: Also in sums: два плюс два = two plus two.
examples: The location is a big plus.
Free parking is a nice plus.
One plus is that it is cheap.
Speaking Spanish is a plus for this job.
The problem is with the hardware, not the software.
He sells computer hardware online.
We need new hardware for the office.
The hardware is old and slow.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian only the unmanned aircraft; a male bee is трутень.
examples: He flies a drone in the park.
The drone took amazing photos of the beach.
Stores may deliver packages by drone soon.
The army uses drones to watch the border.
He is the new boxing champ.
The champ defended his title again.
Hey, champ, great game today!
She has been the chess champ for years.
The baron lived in a large castle.
He was made a baron by the king.
The baron owned all the land around the village.
The old baron had no children.

meaning_hint: Only media/web content; content (satisfied) is задоволений, the contents of a box is вміст.
examples: She makes content for social media.
I like the content on this channel.
We post new content every week.
This website has great free content.
note: Uncountable: "a lot of content", not "contents". Stress the first part: CON-tent.

examples: I asked my question on a forum.
This forum has good tips for travelers.
Read the forum before you post.
I found the answer in an online forum.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian only the computer sense; a waiter (US server) is офіціант.
examples: The server is down right now.
Our website runs on a fast server.
The data is stored on the server.
The company bought new servers.

meaning_hint: Do not confuse with 'heroine' (a female hero).
examples: Heroin is a very dangerous drug.
He was addicted to heroin.
Police seized heroin at the border.
She got help to quit heroin.
The bathroom is at the end of the corridor.
Kids were running down the corridor.
The corridor was long and dark.
Her office is down the corridor on the left.
note: "Hallway" or "hall" is more common for homes.

meaning_hint: культ = worship (культ особи); a religious sect is usually секта; a cult film = культовий фільм.
examples: He left the cult after ten years.
The cult leader controlled his followers.
Her family joined a strange cult.
The movie is about a dangerous cult.
Thanks for your feedback on my report.
We need more feedback from customers.
The teacher gave me helpful feedback.
Positive feedback makes people work harder.
note: Uncountable: some feedback, not "a feedback" or "feedbacks".
